title: BeamNG.Earth
description: The whole Earth, streamed around you by the BeamNG.Earth companion server. Start the server, then pick a place below or teleport from the BeamNG.Earth window. Preview: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 by EOX IT Services GmbH (CC BY 4.0).
biome: Every biome on Earth: oceans, deserts, rainforests, forests, grasslands, tundra, mountains and ice
roads: About 64 million km of roads in every country: motorways, highways, city streets, rural and dirt roads
features: The real planet from open data: terrain, roads, bridges, tunnels, buildings, forests, lakes, seas, airports and live weather

spawnPoints.description: The last place you teleported to.
A road somewhere in the world, picked at random each time.
